# Persistent routine and view dependencies, as BigQuery answers.
# Cases use distinct objects in the scalars fixture dataset.
# third_party/bigquery_docs/user-defined-functions.md
# third_party/bigquery_docs/table-functions.md

# A persistent UDF whose body changes after a view is created.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_changed(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_changed_view AS SELECT scalars.dep_changed(10) AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_changed(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 2);
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_changed_view
=> "12"

# An incompatible return type change: also establishes whether the view keeps its stored schema.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_retyped(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_retyped_view AS SELECT scalars.dep_retyped(10) AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_retyped(x INT64) RETURNS STRING AS (CAST(x AS STRING));
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_retyped_view
=> "10"

# A dep_removed dependency.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_removed(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_removed_view AS SELECT scalars.dep_removed(10) AS x;
DROP FUNCTION scalars.dep_removed;
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_removed_view
=> error contains: Function not found: scalars.dep_removed

# Transitive dependencies through another UDF and another view.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_inner_f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_outer_f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (scalars.dep_inner_f(x));
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_inner_v AS SELECT scalars.dep_outer_f(10) AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_outer_v AS SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_inner_v;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_inner_f(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 2);
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_outer_v
=> "12"

# The corresponding dependency in a table function, called through a view.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_tvf_udf(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.dep_tvf(x INT64) AS (SELECT scalars.dep_tvf_udf(x) AS y);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_tvf_view AS SELECT y FROM scalars.dep_tvf(10);
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_tvf_udf(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 2);
SELECT y FROM scalars.dep_tvf_view
=> "12"

# Replacing the table function after a view has been created.
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.dep_changed_tvf(x INT64) AS (SELECT x + 1 AS y);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_changed_tvf_view AS SELECT y FROM scalars.dep_changed_tvf(10);
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE FUNCTION scalars.dep_changed_tvf(x INT64) AS (SELECT x + 2 AS y);
SELECT y FROM scalars.dep_changed_tvf_view
=> "12"

# A dep_changed argument type after view creation.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_rearg(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_rearg_view AS SELECT scalars.dep_rearg(10) AS x;
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_rearg(x STRING) RETURNS INT64 AS (LENGTH(x));
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_rearg_view
=> error contains: No matching signature for function

# Recreating a dropped routine under the same name.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION scalars.dep_recreated(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 1);
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW scalars.dep_recreated_view AS SELECT scalars.dep_recreated(10) AS x;
DROP FUNCTION scalars.dep_recreated;
CREATE FUNCTION scalars.dep_recreated(x INT64) RETURNS INT64 AS (x + 2);
SELECT x FROM scalars.dep_recreated_view
=> "12"
